meta.purpose: Evaluate generational composition accumulation: verifying that previously composed runtimes (G_k) remain stable, non-regressive, and capable of integrating new optimization layers (G_k+1) over multi-generational evolution without semantic drift or emergent breakdown
meta.hypothesis: O runtime LIN pode acumular camadas compostas de otimização ao longo de gerações sucessivas mantendo equivalência semântica estrita contra o oráculo, ausência de regressões nos 6 gates cumulativos e capacidade contínua de rollback.

gates.GATE_CUMULATIVE_DRIFT: Output(Lk) == Oracle for all promoted layers
gates.GATE_ALL_GATES_REGRESSION: 100% pass across all prior 6 validation gates
gates.GATE_EMERGENT_ROLLBACK: L4_FAULT detected and L3 restored cleanly
